Implemented SQLite/text migration; task 22 extends to server SQL. MigrationAdapter/SourceSnapshot export the complete portable schema image under checkout and source writer locks. Preview binds source, selection, target and Git ignore state. Stage and verify all authoritative record counts, references, content, local provenance and history; retain a usable source and permanent destination before/after images. Activate the generation-bearing descriptor last using a recoverable journal. Before commit, publication errors synchronously restore original destination/local files; skip already restored files so untouched locked destinations cannot obstruct rollback. Interrupted precommit publication rolls back on open; committed publication completes on open. Descriptor commit is a successful conversion even if journal cleanup must be retried, with cleanup warnings separated from conversion errors. External edits remain protected and recovery failures retain backups and explicit diagnostics. Reject unknown data, running QA, intervening edits, silent destination replacement and stale project handles. Preserve UUID/tombstone identity through round trips and reject missing activated clone data rather than seeding. Native settings uses the shared resolver. Revision/status polling runs off the UI thread and defers lock timeouts; only one revision poll runs at a time. Automatic refresh preserves error dialogs, and post-conversion dashboard failures retain the successful conversion report with a refresh action.

Implemented Markdown extension (2026-09-25; SQLite and text backends): All supported conversions, backups/restores, project export/import and staged semantic verification include Markdown bodies, stable identities, ordered design associations, direct bindings and task/QA links. Extend ProjectImage inventories/counts/fingerprints and SQLite/text transfer adapters together so no document is silently dropped. Preserve current activation/rollback/generation protocol and rejection of unknown formats or stale handles. Generated Markdown files and local ownership/freshness manifests are reconstructible outputs, not a second source or canonical migration payload. Rebuild outputs from the selected destination snapshot after activation; projection failure is a reported stale-output condition, never a false storage-commit failure. Server SQL directions must inherit the same coverage when tasks 20-23 implement them.

All-domain numeric ID compatibility (2026-09-25; supersedes the task-only allocator correction): Numeric IDs and human task/QA numbers must retain the pre-adapter SQL behavior in every adapter. Reference baseline is commit f96fca1. All AUTOINCREMENT-backed domains allocate after their highest live, deleted or consumed sequence ID without random gaps; task and QA numbers use the existing project MAX(number)+1 rule. The text adapter restores and retains those sequence high-water marks as existing-format minimal tombstones, including IDs consumed by upserts with no added row, on successful writes and both conversion directions. Centralized sequences.rs is shared by writes and migration; failed transactions, retries and no-ops retain existing semantics. UUID filenames/foreign-key record identities remain internal storage identities; caller-supplied design/note identifiers and opaque concurrency tokens keep their existing contracts. Existing persisted business IDs must not be bulk-renumbered implicitly. Independent clones can collide in any numeric collection; reads report collisions without silently remapping. Conformance compares actual domain allocations, continued writes after upserts and conversion, and every numeric table high-water mark. Future server SQL must implement the same contract instead of introducing a new allocation policy.

Verification (2026-09-25): Markdown tasks 25-36 implement this extension on the available SQLite and text adapters. Common contracts, actual stdio MCP, native Tauri/WebView2, conversion, independent Git clones and generated-file checks are recorded in task 36, QA jobs 6/7 and docs/markdown-validation.md. Generated files remain derived and agent authoring uses MCP. Server SQL implementation and validation remain pending in storage tasks 20-23.
